title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
description: Trump's threat on Oman, which has been holding its own talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, comes as a 60-day window for peace negotiations expires.

title: Actors lead tributes to 'amazing' Hayden Panettiere after Heroes star dies aged 36
description: The US actress, who has died at the age of 36, starred in the TV shows Heroes and Nashville.

title: Burnham exchanged messages with person posing as Trump's chief of staff
description: Downing Street has declined to comment on the security breach, first reported by Politico.
